# Mervin's Hub (ngyuhang.com)

> Portfolio of Ng Yu Hang, who goes by Mervin: a full-stack AI developer and data scientist in Singapore, studying Applied AI & Analytics at Singapore Polytechnic. He builds AI agents, machine learning and computer vision models, agentic RAG systems, and the full-stack apps around them.

## About
- Name: Ng Yu Hang (Mervin)
- Location: Singapore
- Role: Full-stack AI Developer / Data Scientist
- Studying: Diploma in Applied AI & Analytics, Singapore Polytechnic
- Award: Bronze medal, National Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (NOAI) 2026, AI Singapore
- Hackathons: Top 3 at 'SUP Build 2026 (SUPAgent), Top 3 at the OpenClaw Hackathon (GrowthLab News), PolyFinTech 2026 finalist (ESG Evidence Engine)
- Certified: AWS Certified AI Practitioner, NVIDIA Fundamentals of Deep Learning, Hugging Face LLM Post Training, IBM Machine Learning and Deep Learning, and 25 more

## Experience
- Influencees: Founding Product & AI Engineer (Sep 2026 to now). Agentic AI features end to end: AI assistants, tool integrations, orchestration workflows, backend, frontend and APIs.
- Reyolk: Founder (Sep 2026 to now). An AI-assisted platform that runs a small business's operations from one place. https://reyolk.app
- SP Data Science & Analytics Centre: Full-Stack AI Engineer, intern (Mar 2026 to now). An Azure RAG chatbot for EM Services, a town council managing agent, and an LLM system that grades Power BI dashboards.
- PetaniAI: AI Researcher / Developer (May to Aug 2026). Tested new AI models and systems and built prototypes on the strongest.
- Singapore Polytechnic, School of Computing: Student Developer (Sep 2025 to Feb 2026). SPOH Chatbot, a paid client project: an end-to-end generative AI chatbot on the cloud, presented to SP's Deputy Principal and hundreds of staff.

## Skills
- AI agents: tool use, guardrails, evals, LangChain, Claude and OpenAI APIs
- Machine learning: regression, classification, clustering, forecasting (scikit-learn, Pandas); deep learning with PyTorch and TensorFlow (CNNs, RNNs, GANs, reinforcement learning, LoRA fine-tuning)
- Computer vision: YOLO, CNNs, OpenCV
- Agentic RAG: embeddings, vector and graph search, Azure AI Search, Supabase, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation
- Full-stack: React, Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js, Postgres, Supabase, Docker, Azure, AWS, Railway

## Selected projects
- [Reyolk](https://reyolk.app): an AI operating system for small service businesses
- [AgentLabs](https://agentlabs-production-efd2.up.railway.app/): attacks AI agents with adversarial prompts, then patches and retests them; trains LoRA adapters for small open models
- [ESG Evidence Engine](https://github.com/fountainnnnn/esg-evidence-engine): research agents that check company ESG claims against evidence, including satellite images
